headline.wave_station_label: Rawley Point East buoy (NDBC 45210) — open lake, deep water

explain.text: Wind has come mostly from the west-northwest and south over the past 3 days. Under PierBite's wind model, wind from that quarter can pull colder water in toward the shore.

headline.wave_station_label: NWS marine forecast — Two Rivers to Sheboygan WI

explain.text: Wind favoured cold water for most of the past 3 days, but it has swung back onshore in the last 12 hours. Under PierBite's wind model, a recent shift like that can push cold water away from the pier before it arrives, so the score is held down.
